answer: At dawn the wharf posts a fresh ledge of adjudication dockets, one per person who has never been judged, and a docket is good only for the first address that presents it - it burns for good, so a farm cannot rent, copy, or lend one human's signature to a second head, while the duplicate line on the ledge exposes the whole cluster. The scarce input is a real person's one and only judgment slot, unprintable and non-transferable between heads, so every extra head needs a new human burned forever, not another core.
